title: GPT and Claude go to heraldry school
partialText: I photographed a mystery coat of arms on vacation and asked a handful of AI models to identify it. Their reasoning traces show the difference between a model that backtracks and one that doubles down.

title: Inserting State Transitions in Postgres
partialText: An append-only status model gives you full history, but concurrent transitions can produce contradictory records. Here's how to prevent that.

title: Don’t hire thoughtbot to write code
partialText: AI makes code faster and cheaper to produce. Premium consultancies need to offer more: experienced judgment, the right capabilities, and people who help teams solve the right problems and make better decisions.

title: AI makes creating software faster, but in regulated industries, judgment matters more
partialText: AI is accelerating software delivery, but regulated industries face a harder challenge: moving faster without increasing risk. Here’s how teams can balance speed with privacy, security, compliance, and accountability.

title: PMs Don't Need to Code, but They Do Need to Understand
partialText: A Product Manager doesn't need to code, but understanding technology can completely change the quality of conversations, decisions, and collaboration with engineering.
